# NCTOH 2026: Workshop Examples

This page presents practical R examples from the NCTOH 2026 workshop.

## Histogram with mean line

```{r, eval=FALSE}
ggplot(data = overall_age_u, aes(x = current_age)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, fill = "pink", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mean(current_age)),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "black")
```

## Categorical bar charts and proportions

```{r, eval=FALSE}
overall_up |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = fuel_type, fill = tobacco_type)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Tobacco type by fuel type")
```

## Pie chart example

```{r, eval=FALSE}
treatment_summary <- overall_up |> 
  count(intervention) |> 
  mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100)

ggplot(treatment_summary, aes(x = "", y = n, fill = intervention)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  theme_void()
```

## Theme and label polish

```{r, eval=FALSE}
plot1 +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "serif") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
```

:::
